pi.frontmatter:
name: reply-polish
description: "输出排版收口层：只在用户点名或说「整理格式 / 输出太乱 / 太长没重点」时，对已写好的回复做收口——首句总判定、并列项一行一条且每条首句先结论、去掉裸 URL 与绝对路径、加粗 ≤5 处。默认收口已在 commander 硬约束里，不作为每轮固定步骤。"

cursor.frontmatter:
name: reply-polish
description: >-
  Final formatting pass, used only when the user asks for it (整理格式 /
  输出太乱 / 太长没重点) or names reply-polish: put one bold verdict on
  the first line, one bullet per parallel item with the conclusion first,
  drop bare URLs and absolute paths, bold at most 5 spots. The default
  pass already lives in commander's hard rules, so this is not a per-turn
  step. Does not change the verdict, the evidence, or a downstream skill's
  fixed layout.
disable-model-invocation: false
